me.title: My expenses
me.text: Claim back money you spent for work. Add the receipts, send it, and follow where it stands.
me.empty_text: Spent money for work? Start a claim and add the receipts.
me.no_kinds_text: Ask the finance office to add the kinds of expense before you claim.
me.not_linked: Your login is not linked to an employee
me.not_linked_text: Ask HR to link your login to your employee record, then claim your expenses here.

editor.title: What was it for
editor.title_hint: For example: Client visit to Chattogram
editor.description_hint: For example: Taxi from the airport
editor.no_rate: No rate per km is set yet. Ask the finance office.
editor.receipt_needed: Above {amount}: add the receipt before sending.
editor.too_big: The file is too big. At most {kb} KB.
editor.rules: A receipt is needed for each expense above {amount}. Expenses older than {days} days cannot be claimed.
editor.sent: Sent. Your approver is told at once.
editor.discard_text: The draft and its receipts are removed. This cannot be undone.
editor.advance_hint: What you spent is taken from the advance first; you get only what is above it.

detail.title: Claim
detail.decide_text: {name} claims {amount}. Check the lines and receipts first.
detail.reject_done: Rejected. The employee is told why.
detail.withdraw_text: {number} will not be decided. You can start a new claim later.
detail.advance_named: Settles an advance: what is owed goes against it first.

pay.title: Pay back
pay.cash_hint: Paid now from cash; written in the books at once.
pay.bank_hint: Paid now by bank transfer; written in the books at once.
pay.period_hint: Added to that month's pay slip, not taxed. Paid when that month's payroll is approved.
pay.done: Marked as paid. The employee is told.
pay.scheduled: Will be paid with that month's salary.

approvals.title: To approve
approvals.text: Claims waiting for your decision. Open one to see the lines and receipts.
approvals.empty_text: When someone you approve for sends a claim, it shows here and in the bell.

claims.title: All claims
claims.text: Sent claims of the people here: pay back the approved ones, decide the second step, find any claim.

categories.title: Kinds of expense
categories.text: What people can claim, and where each kind goes in the books.
categories.empty_text: Add the usual ones (travel, meals, office, phone, other) or your own.
categories.name: Name
categories.account_hint: Accounting links each of these to an account in your chart.
categories.mileage_hint: People write the kilometres; the amount is worked out at the rate per km set in the rules.
categories.per_diem_hint: People write the days and choose the place; the amount is the rule's daily rate. No receipt needed.

portal.title: My expense claims
portal.text: Where your claims stand. To claim, use the app.
portal.empty: No employee record is linked to you here.

advance.title: Advance
advance.none: No advances. Going on a trip? Ask for money before you spend it.
advance.ask_text: Money before you spend it, settled later by your claims. At most {max} at a time.
advance.settle_by_hint: Leave empty for the usual days after it is paid.
advance.purpose_hint: For example: Trip to Chattogram for the audit
advance.sent: Advance asked for. Your approver is told.
advance.from_salary: To come from the salary of {month}
advance.reject_done: Rejected. The employee is told why.
advance.paid: Advance paid out. The employee is told.
advance.to_salary: What is left will come from that month's salary.
advance.returned: Handed back: the advance is settled.
advance.empty_overdue: No advance is past its day
